title: Verify: backend/worker is gone and not imported unit tests
summary: Filesystem unit test proving the worker module is deleted and unreferenced.
description: Add a unit test that stats backend/worker and scans backend Go files for worker imports.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backend tree, when ../../worker is stat'ed, then it is not found.
Given backend Go files, when scanned, then none contain storyforge/worker.
